text: CN_ShanShui, a minimalist composition focusing on a solitary fishing boat floating on the open water. The boat is long and narrow, depicted with a few simple, expressive dark strokes. The vast negative space and the coarse grain of the fibrous antique paper create a serene, poetic atmosphere of isolation.

CN_ShanShui, a wide-angle panoramic view of a traditional Chinese landscape painting. The background consists of continuous rolling earthen hills and ridges, rendered with soft, long hemp-fiber strokes (Pi Ma Cun) and layered with dense, dark moss dots to represent vegetation. A vast, calm river expanse occupies the center and foreground, represented by negative space. In the lower right foreground, a group of figures stands on a flat, extending sandbar, while a boat with a canopy and passengers drifts nearby in the open water. To the far right, clusters of withered reeds are depicted with swift, dark calligraphic strokes. Several tiny, distant fishing boats are visible in the background water. The image features a dim, sepia-toned antique texture on worn silk, with two red collector seals visible in the upper right corner, evoking a serene, misty, and expansive autumnal atmosphere.

A wide, calm river winds through the mid-ground, its surface represented by vast negative space and faint ink washes.
